payload_cleanup_command:
dir=/var/tmp/openaev-created-art
# Only the state this payload's run left: a directory of root's, holding the UID record it wrote.
[ -e "$dir" ] || [ -L "$dir" ] || exit 0
if ! { [ -d "$dir" ] && [ ! -L "$dir" ] && [ "$(stat -c %u "$dir")" = 0 ] \
    && [ -f "$dir/uid" ] && [ ! -L "$dir/uid" ] && [ "$(stat -c %u:%a "$dir/uid")" = 0:600 ]; }; then
  echo "$dir is not the state this payload leaves: nothing is removed, check it by hand" >&2
  exit 1
fi
uid=$(cat "$dir/uid")
if [ "$(id -u art 2>/dev/null)" = "$uid" ]; then
  userdel art || { echo "the account art could not be removed: its state is kept in $dir" >&2; exit 1; }
fi
rm -rf "$dir"
payload_description: Create a local account named art with the password art, its home in a directory of the run's own, switch to it to run whoami, then remove both: an account named art that already exists, or anything already where the run keeps its state, is left as it is, and nothing is created. Run it once at a time on an endpoint: the cleanup of a run that created nothing removes the account of another run still holding it.
